title: sys-prompt.md
brief: A complete agent-harness system prompt as a gist: JSON tool schemas for edit, glob, grep, question, read, shell, subagent, and write with execution semantics spelled out. Useful reference if you're building or tuning a coding-agent CLI.
details: A gist by Sewer56 publishing a `sys-prompt.md` — the system prompt and tool definitions for an agent harness, documenting its full tool surface as JSON schemas: edit, glob, grep, question (ask-the-user with choices), read (files, directories, images, PDFs), shell (zsh commands with timeouts and background execution), subagent (spawning child sessions, including codebase-explorer and web-search specialists), and write. Useful as a reference for what a well-specified agent tool API looks like — exact shapes, required fields, and behavioral notes (e.g., line-number prefixes are not part of file content; background commands notify on completion). If you are designing tool definitions for your own agent, this is a concrete template to crib from.
